messages:
Maria S.: @Auditor_Jess quick one — your checklist asks for 'keystore usage + RBAC change evidence (90d)'. Do you prefer raw CloudTrail exports or our prepackaged evidence bundle in secure S3?

Auditor_Jess: Bundle is preferred. Need per-request principal/key-id/action/result + rotation events and a control crosswalk to SOC2/ISO IDs. Also note any ingestion gaps.

Kevin L.: We can drop: kms-requests.csv, kms-rotations.json, rbac-change-log.csv, approval-artifacts.zip, index.md (control mapping). ETA EOD. Any required sample rows for manual review?

Auditor_Jess: Please include 3 redacted request rows (principal redacted but consistent format) for sampling. Also flag any auth failures explicitly.

Dmitri: FYI we had a collector gap on 2024-11-05 03:1003:45 UTC in eu-west-1 (INC-2024-451). Backfill completed; will attach backfill.log and incident ticket.

Lina (infra): Packaging path will be s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1758888888/{kms-requests.csv,kms-rotations.json,rbac-change-log.csv,backfill.log,index.md}. index.md will map each file to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9 controls and include short rationale.

Maria S.: The RBAC change is PR https://github.com/redwood/platform-admin/pull/2150 1 shows service-account removal and approver. Will attach git log snippet + approver Slack confirm. Also include vuln triage note: CVE-2024-9999 mitigation.

Kevin L.: Export snippet for reproducibility:
```
splunk search "index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:kms (ActionName=Decrypt OR ActionName=GenerateDataKey*)" -earliest "-90d" | outputcsv kms-requests.csv
aws s3 cp kms-requests.csv s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1758888888/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

Auditor_Jess: That should work. Once uploaded I'll validate and follow up if anything's missing. Thanks.

Oncall-Bot: INC-2024-451 backfill confirmed by dmitri at 2024-11-06T09:12:07Z. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1758888888/backfill.log :white_check_mark:
